name: Thermal Fracture
primary:
A sudden temperature swing cracks the stone.
A zone at the aim point with a 2-block radius for 3 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 1 ❤ fire + 1 ❤ earth (fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Cold 40: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• If the target is frozen or brittle: damage 3.5 ❤ thermal
• Light push
• Blocks within 2 blocks turn brittle for 8 s
self_description:
On you:
• Damage 1 ❤ fire + 1.75 ❤ thermal (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Cold 40: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• If the target is frozen or brittle: damage 3.5 ❤ thermal
• Stone skin (Resistance I) for 7.7 s
• Slowness I for 6.05 s
